About Los Cabos

Los Cabos sits where the desert meets the sea at the tip of Baja California, pairing dramatic rock arches with resort beaches and world-class sportfishing.

Best time to visit Los Cabos

The sweet spot is generally Oct–May — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Los Cabos

  • Photograph El Arco at Land's End by boat
  • Swim and snorkel at Playa del Amor
  • Whale-watch (Dec-Apr)
  • Stroll the San Jose del Cabo art district
  • Sunset on the Cabo San Lucas marina

Good to know

Generally safe. Language: Spanish. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, up to 180 days.
